text:
Ava (CEO): Quick follow-up from today's all-hands — this thread is for questions about hiring, headcount allocations, and the org tweaks we mentioned. Samir, Lindsey, Riley and Jonas will chime in. Please keep questions short. Thanks! 

Morgan (SWE): Thanks! Curious where the majority of new engineering slots are going? runtime vs infra vs sres?

Samir (Head of Eng): Priority is serving runtime and platform reliability this quarter. We'll allocate most of the hiring capacity to Runtime (latency/kv cache/compilation) and Infra-SRE. Expect ~20 new eng IC reqs opening next quarter split roughly 60/40 runtime+infra. Not final numbers, but that's the plan. :chart_with_upwards_trend:

Tess (SWE): Any changes to manager hiring? will we see new TL/EM roles or just IC hiring?

Lindsey (People Ops): We'll be hiring a few EMs to support growing pods and running a manager apprenticeship program. We want to promote internal folks where possible; expect manager reqs to be posted alongside IC reqs. We'll also run internal info sessions next week. :sparkles:

Jonas (Recruiter): For candidates: we will prioritize internal referrals and folks in the interview pipeline. Interview turnaround goal is 2-3 weeks from screen to loop for priority roles. If you have candidate referrals, add them to the hiring board or DM me. :email:

Riley (VP Product): On the product side, we're splitting Product into Core Platform (model-serving, infra integrations) and Developer Experience (console, SDKs, docs). Each will pair with eng pods; no change to existing PM headcount, just clearer ownership and faster rollouts.

Kai (Manager, Serving Runtime): How will ownership look for the runtime/compile work? will it be centralized runtime team or embedded across pods?

Samir (Head of Eng): Runtime will stay a centralized team that partners with product and infra pods. We'll create cross-functional feature squads for big initiatives (e.g., long-context, KV caching) with rotation windows. Org change effective target: 2026-05-15. No layoffs — just rebalancing and new hires. :white_check_mark:

Ava (CEO): We'll publish the updated org map, req list, and the hiring timeline in People Ops docs and the all-hands follow-up doc later today. Appreciate the questions — keep them coming in this thread. 

Ava (CEO): Quick link to draft (internal): https://redwood-internal.company/docs/all-hands/may2026-hiring-plan
